summary: P1 Wave C Feature 1: Shadow IT Detector - Complete testing. Backend: 18/18 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements and interactions verified working. Feature is zero-LLM cost - pure rule-based regex matching against 40+ patterns in RISK_DB.

issues: Console warning: chart width/height -1 - minor recharts sizing issue, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: shadow_it.py: Well-structured with 40+ RISK_DB patterns covering file_sharing, remote_access, unapproved_vpn, ai_tool, messaging, crypto_mining, torrent_p2p categories
Baseline management: Default baseline includes Microsoft Office, Chrome, Zoom, Slack, etc. Custom baselines persist per-client
Scan logic: Properly purges old open findings before inserting new ones, aggregates by app across devices
Actions: approve adds to baseline, create_ticket creates security ticket with proper priority mapping, ignore marks status
ShadowItPage.jsx: Clean implementation with all required data-testid attributes for testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all UI elements and interactions verified

seed_data_creation: Used /api/shadow-it/seed-demo to populate 135+ devices with demo software
